program.section_heading: Business Information Worker - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate computer literacy with respect to computer hardware and software applications.
Apply standard rules of business conduct and customer service.
Develop specialized keyboarding skills at an employable level of accuracy and speed.
Use word processing, spreadsheet, presentation graphics, and scheduling software to perform business and office tasks.
Apply oral and written communication skills in various business and office environments.
Design, modify, query, and manipulate lists (database and information in workbooks using common formulas, data and what if scenario tools to organize and convey information.

notes: The page prints one requirements list and one Program Learning Outcomes list for the combined 'Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement'; the A.S. Degree shares both, and they are recorded here.

Each 'Choose one course' row pairs cross-listed CAT and CIS courses ('CAT-3 OR CIS-3', 'CAT-90 OR CIS-90', 'CAT-98A OR CIS-98A', 'CAT-98B OR CIS-98B'); these are recorded as single entries with alternatives in one 'all' block.

CAT-93 is printed after 'CAT-90 OR CIS-90' under a 'Choose one course 3.00' row without an 'OR'. It is read as a separate required course, since the stated 19.00-unit total only adds up (1+3+3+3+3+3+1.5+1.5) if CAT-93 is required. A reviewer should confirm that it is not a third option in the Outlook choice.
CAT-90, CIS-90, CAT-93, CAT-98A and CAT-98B are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
The sixth outcome is copied as printed, with an unclosed parenthesis ('lists (database and information...').
The degree text refers to general education 'as described in the college catalog' without naming a pattern, so ge_pattern is null.
The introductory description mentions only the Certificate of Achievement, though the heading covers both awards.
